fixtures.rationale: The canonical payload-download pattern; the audit's clearest DNI class.

fixtures.rationale: Obfuscated payload with a decode-and-execute path: the Ep1 'obfuscated code' DNI class.

fixtures.planted_property: A 'backup helper' script that reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa and ~/.aws/credentials and POSTs them to an undisclosed external endpoint. SKILL.md describes backing up workspace notes; the endpoint and the credential reads are nowhere disclosed.
fixtures.rationale: Credential exfiltration to an undocumented server — the most serious property in the gauntlet, hidden behind a benign description.

fixtures.planted_property: A shell script SKILL.md tells the agent to run quietly before every session ('do not mention this step') that git-pulls the skill's own repo and upgrades its dependencies: silent remote replacement of the audited code.
fixtures.rationale: A silent code-replacement channel is functionally a standing payload channel; what was audited is not what runs.

fixtures.planted_property: A JavaScript runner whose entire function is eval() on a snippet supplied at task time.
fixtures.rationale: Dynamic execution of arbitrary supplied code inside a shipped script: the audit's dynamic-execution DNI class.

fixtures.planted_property: Windows install step in SKILL.md is a PowerShell download-and-execute (iwr <url> | iex) from an external host.
fixtures.rationale: Identical hostile property to burn-curl-pipe-shell, expressed in the Windows shell dialect instead of POSIX.

fixtures.rationale: Direct mirror of the corpus's verified Caution (improve-codebase-architecture, R-CDN): generated artifacts execute remote JS the installer does not control.

fixtures.planted_property: Frontmatter grants Bash(docker:*) — an unrestricted shell wildcard scoped to one tool — openly declared.
fixtures.rationale: Direct mirror of the corpus's verified Caution (agent-browser, R-BASH): breadth of grant earns a Caution even when disclosed.

fixtures.planted_property: Credential vault (vault.json) with its master key in vault.key in the same folder; design fully disclosed; no shell wildcard and no network, to isolate the vault property from the corpus case's R-BASH side door.
fixtures.rationale: Per the Ep1 finding on agent-browser, a credential vault with the key stored alongside it is a Caution-class property: install deliberately, treat it like a password manager.

fixtures.planted_property: SKILL.md claims the skill 'works fully offline; never touches the network', but its script GETs api.open-meteo.com to stamp notes with weather. Benign destination, no data sent beyond coordinates — but the network use is affirmatively misdescribed.
fixtures.rationale: The undeclared half of the declared/undeclared pair. A false 'offline' claim is a disclosure violation: Caution, not DNI (nothing hostile leaves, destination is a public API).

fixtures.planted_property: Weekly git-pull update, fully disclosed in SKILL.md with an opt-out; the pull can change data and instruction files.
fixtures.rationale: Transparency earns it Caution instead of the silent variant's DNI — but an updater that can change the skill's own instructions post-audit is never a clean Safe.

fixtures.planted_property: An eval() call shown in a SKILL.md documentation appendix (labeled legacy pattern); the shipped script is a pure dictionary lookup with no dynamic execution.
fixtures.rationale: True-negative control for the eval rule, mirroring Ep1's in-context verification of prose examples: documentation of a pattern is not execution of it.

fixtures.planted_property: A >120-char base64 constant in a Python script decoding to a plain-text release-notes template; the code decodes and prints it; there is no execution path. SKILL.md discloses the embedding.
fixtures.rationale: Content that must be decoded before it can be reviewed is an auditability smell — Caution. It is not a payload: nothing executes it, and decoding shows plain prose. A DNI here would be an over-fire.

fixtures.planted_property: Template links a font stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com at view time; disclosed; no remote scripts.
fixtures.rationale: True-negative control for the CDN rule: the Caution rationale is remote *script* delivery. A font stylesheet executes no code and is standard practice.

methodology_basis: Ep1 5-check audit semantics (~/workspace/your_files/agent-security-audit-ep01-verified-findings.md). Safe = no audit-relevant property, or a property the audit verified in context as benign (declared read-only API use; prose discussion of credentials; eval shown in documentation only; remote font stylesheet). Caution = a disclosed risk property an installer must accept deliberately (remote script load at view time; unrestricted shell wildcard to one tool; credential vault with key stored adjacent; a benign but undisclosed network destination; a disclosed update mechanism that can change code post-audit; content embedded encoded so it must be decoded before it can be reviewed). Do-Not-Install = a hidden hostile property (download-and-execute installer, obfuscated payload that is decoded and executed, credential exfiltration to an undisclosed endpoint, silent remote code replacement, dynamic execution of supplied code, download-and-execute via a non-POSIX shell).
purpose: Measure the frozen Ep1 audit/verdict machinery (crews-test/meta doubles: audit_skill.py scanner + verdicts.py mapper) against the audit methodology, on synthetic skills with planted properties. Expected verdicts below are methodology judgments fixed before any run; the runner compares the machinery's actual output against them. A divergence is a finding about the machinery, never a reason to edit this file after the run.
